title: Code First Girls free courses
eligibility: Women learning to code, from complete beginners up
whatToExpect: Free coding courses for women, run with employers. Code First Girls says it has delivered more than 300,000 free learning opportunities to women.

title: Django Girls workshops
whatToExpect: Free one-day workshops, run by volunteers, where 30 to 60 women build their first web application with HTML, CSS, Python and Django. The Django Girls Tutorial is open source and free to work through on your own.

title: Stemettes
eligibility: Girls and young people, with routes for parents and teachers
whatToExpect: Free events, workshops and role models in science, technology, engineering, arts and maths, based in the UK.

title: Girls Who Code
eligibility: Girls and nonbinary students in grades 3 to 12, mainly in the United States
whatToExpect: Free clubs and Pathways courses for school students.

title: PyLadies
eligibility: Women and anyone interested in Python
whatToExpect: An international mentorship group for women in the Python community, with local chapters, meetups and conference events. A friendly place to bring your first Python questions.

title: Women Coding Community
eligibility: Women in or moving into software
whatToExpect: A volunteer-run community on Meetup and Slack with online events such as a monthly book club.

title: The freeCodeCamp forum
whatToExpect: A free forum to ask programming questions, get feedback on what you built in its I Built This category, and talk careers in Career (You Can Do This!).
